item.title: Customer Success Manager
item.description:
About ClearGrid

ClearGrid is revolutionizing the debt resolution industry with cutting-edge AI and advanced analytics. We leverage real-time data, machine learning, and automation to optimize debt recovery for financial institutions. As we scale our technology platform, we are building high-performance, resilient systems to support our next phase of hyper-growth.

About the role

ClearGrid works with some of the largest lenders, banks and BNPL providers in Saudi Arabia, through our licensed collections agency and Command, our AI-driven collections platform. Our Saudi clients expect a partner who is in the room with them: at in-person meetings and on site on launch day. This role is that partner.

You will own ClearGrid's KSA client portfolio, from pilot and proof of value through launch, day-to-day operations, renewal and expansion. You will be the person our clients trust with their collections performance, which means three things: running the relationship at every level of the client, running the operations behind their campaigns, and understanding the data well enough to know exactly why a number moved and what to do about it.

This is mostly a run role with some build. There is a live portfolio to manage from day one, and room to shape how Customer Success works in Saudi Arabia as we grow.

What you'll own

  • Your KSA client portfolio, end to end: proofs of value, onboarding, launch, adoption, retention, renewal and expansion. You own recurring revenue, net revenue retention, churn, PoV success, daily active usage, client engagement and account health.

  • Proofs of value and launches: taking pipeline clients through a successful PoV and into launch, and being on the ground in Riyadh when they go live.

  • Day-to-day portfolio operations: starting each day with a review of portfolio health, investigating any significant drop, and running client campaigns across calls, SMS and email from updated client payment files.

  • Client projects: leading client-specific initiatives with our Product and Engineering teams, such as new AI capabilities and prompt changes, from scoping to go-live.

  • Senior client relationships: multi-threading each account from operations and collections teams up to Credit Risk, Collections and leadership, and being the trusted advisor they call first. That includes in-person meetings with clients across the Kingdom.

  • Performance insight: reading the full collections funnel (right party contact, promise to pay, kept promises, roll rates and recovery against target), diagnosing why performance moves, and turning it into recommendations that lift recovery rates, cost to collect and operations.

  • Account strategy: a written account plan for every client, covering stakeholders, goals, risks and growth opportunities, kept current.

  • Revenue growth from the portfolio: spotting and leading expansion, from Allocate to Command, new portfolios and buckets and new product modules, working with Sales on commercials.

  • A disciplined client cadence: weekly check-ins, monthly business reviews and quarterly business reviews, backed by sharp reporting and analysis, plus ad hoc meetings as clients need them.

  • Deep product expertise: knowing Command, Journeys, our AI agents and reporting at a granular level.

  • Cross-functional partnership: acting as the voice of the client to Growth, Data, Product, Engineering, QA, Conversation Design and Finance.

  • Compliance and data residency: working within SAMA's debt collection regulations, the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and KSA data residency requirements, handling in-country data matters on the client's behalf, and helping clients stay compliant when they use ClearGrid.

What we're looking for

  • 6 to 8 years of customer success in B2B SaaS experience. A background in collections technology is ideal.

  • Proven external, client-facing experience, with a track record of owning retention and expansion numbers for a portfolio of enterprise clients, not just supporting them.

  • Client presence: credible with senior banking and fintech leaders, energised by client-facing work, and able to manage client expectations and hold a firm position when needed.

  • Strongly analytical: at home in dashboards and spreadsheets, able to find the story in client data and explain it simply.

  • Tech-savvy and AI-fluent: you use AI tools every day to research, analyse and prepare, and you can pressure-test their output rather than take it at face value.

  • Operational and hands-on: comfortable running campaigns and day-to-day client operations, not only the strategy above them.

  • An independent, self-driven problem solver with high ownership.

  • Fluent in English and Arabic (required).

  • Knowledge of SAMA's debt collection regulations, PDPL, data residency or the Saudi lending market is a strong plus.

  • Based in Riyadh (required), and willing to travel within KSA and to Dubai as needed.

item.title: Conversation Designer
item.description:
About ClearGrid
ClearGrid is revolutionizing the debt resolution industry with cutting-edge AI and advanced analytics. We leverage real-time data, machine learning, and automation to optimize debt recovery for financial institutions. As we scale our technology platform, we are building high-performance, resilient systems to support our next phase of hyper-growth.

About the role
Our AI agents hold thousands of voice conversations with customers every day. We’re now launching Hindi conversations and hiring our first Hindi-speaking Conversation Designer. Your job is to make Hindi a strength of our product and keep its quality on par with English as we scale.

This is a remote role based in India. You’ll join the conversation design team and report to the Conversation Quality Lead. You’ll design our Hindi AI agents and help set the standard for what excellent Hindi sounds like in our product. You’ll also work across the wider design workload: structuring requirements, designing conversations in Hindi and English, and writing and refining the prompts that bring those designs to life.

What you’ll own

  • Design conversations for new voice AI agents, for new and existing clients, including conversation flows, dialogue structure, copy, and edge-case handling.

  • Lead Hindi conversation design: design, review, and launch Hindi agents, and act as the team’s go-to voice on the linguistic and cultural quality of Hindi conversations.

  • Write, test, and iterate on prompts for our agents, working closely with prompt engineers to turn designs into working agents.

  • Prepare clear handover packages (requirements, conversation designs, and guidelines) so the team can build with no open questions.

  • Work with the analytics team to track agent performance, report on the impact of your design changes, and recommend the next optimizations for each agent.

  • Run conversation quality reviews on live agents, covering quality dimensions outside compliance QA.

  • Contribute to our conversation design standards and methodology, and help improve the processes the team relies on.

  • Drive our north-star metric: the conversion of promises-to-pay into kept promises.

What we’re looking for

  • Native or fully fluent Hindi speaker. This is non-negotiable. You speak, read, and write Hindi fluently in Devanagari script, can hear when a conversation sounds off, and can explain exactly why.

  • Natural, everyday conversational Hindi. You know how real customers speak, including comfortable Hindi–English code-switching, and can write dialogue that sounds human rather than textbook.

  • Strong written and spoken English.

  • At least 1 year of hands-on conversation design or prompt engineering experience on production Voice AI agents. You’ve worked on a voice agent that went live with real users.

  • Data skills. You can track and report on agent performance and use data to show the impact of your design decisions.

  • Strong ownership. You work well in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where structure is still being built.

  • Rigor and attention to detail. You treat documentation, reviews, and quality checks as core parts of the job, not afterthoughts.

  • Curiosity about where voice AI and conversational interfaces are heading.

  • Able to work hours that overlap with our Dubai team (GMT+4).

Nice to have

  • A background in Hindi linguistics.

  • Experience in fintech, collections, or outbound operations.

  • Familiarity with how Hindi behaves in speech-to-text and text-to-speech systems (pronunciation, transliteration, numbers and dates).

item.title: Debt Resolution Specialist
item.description:
Job Summary:
The Debt Resolution Specialist is responsible for managing the recovery of overdue accounts, using a proactive and customer-centric approach. This role requires expertise in debt collection, a strong understanding of recovery strategies, and a focus on maintaining positive customer relations while ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Debt Collection:

    • Manage and directly handle debt recovery efforts for overdue accounts.

    • Develop and implement tailored debt resolution strategies based on customer circumstances.

    • Initiate contact with delinquent customers to negotiate settlements, payment plans, or full debt recovery.

  2. Customer Relationship Management:

    • Maintain professional relationships with customers, ensuring a balance between firm collections and customer empathy.

    • Address complex or escalated customer accounts, working toward effective and amicable resolutions.

    • Resolve disputes and complaints while upholding a positive image for the company.

  3. Compliance and Regulation:

    • Ensure adherence to all relevant debt collection laws, regulations, and company policies.

    • Stay informed on industry trends and legal changes to ensure best practices in the debt resolution process.

  4. Performance Monitoring and Reporting:

    • Track personal performance metrics, including recovery rates and customer engagement.

    • Prepare and present reports on recovery activities, outlining key results and areas for improvement.

    • Regularly assess and adjust collection strategies to meet company recovery goals.

  5. Operational Efficiency:

    • Continuously seek ways to streamline debt collection processes for improved productivity.

    • Utilize collection software and tools to track progress and maintain accurate records.

  6. Collaboration and Stakeholder Management:

    • Work with internal teams to coordinate and support the overall debt recovery process.

    • Collaborate with external agencies or partners as needed to facilitate collections.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a debt collection agent, with a minimum of 2 years in debt resolution.

  • Experience in GCC based debt collection agencies.

  • In-depth knowledge of debt collection laws, regulations, and best practices.

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage delicate conversations and resolve disputes.

  • Proficiency in debt collection software and tools.

  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

  • Ability to handle high-pressure situations and manage customer concerns professionally.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification in debt collection or related field.

  • Fluency in Arabic and English
